ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Probabilistic Methods for Biological Sequence Analysis. This course will present some of the important research topics pertaining to the computational processing of genomic sequences, focusing on probabilistic approaches to the problem. Computational techniques will be discussed in the context of the important biological process of gene regulation, and problems such as sequence alignment, motif finding, and module detection, will be studied in detail. A recurrent theme of the course will be comparative genomics -- the paradigm of examining data from multiple species for improving the extracted signal.
